messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning version bumps across API / runtime / console / SDKs for tomorrow's cut. Can folks confirm owners and any blockers? target cutoff: EOD PDT tomorrow.

maria: I'm taking API + SDKs. Need to finish the client auth change; PR #4021 is in review. If tests pass, I can bump to `v1.12.0` today.

jamie: I'll own runtime and console. Runtime needs a small kernel selector change (PR #908) and a release note about batch size default. Console change is just a patch; will open the bump PR after runtime merges.

kai: pinging re: onprem packaging — I'll validate the private deploy artifacts post-bump. No blockers from infra side unless we need a backport.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: release-train will start 2025-05-14T23:00:00Z. CI windows: build-matrix-1, integration-sanity. Note: `canary=true` by default for runtime._

alex: Thanks. Two quick asks: (1) Add a one-line changelog entry in each PR (see template). (2) Use branch name pattern `release/bump-<repo>-v<semver>` so the release tool picks it up.

maria: changelog added to #4021. Branch `release/bump-api-v1.12.0` created.

jamie: runtime PR merged main -> `release/bump-runtime-v2.7.0` opened, console PR draft at #409.

kai: validated artifacts for runtime canary on staging—no regressions on startup. checksum: `sha256:9f3a...c1d`.

alex: Nice. One more: if any repo can't make cutoff, post here by 16:00 PDT so we decide fallback (defer SDK bump or decouple console). Also tag me for merges — I'll be on merge duty during the window.

maria: FYI async: API has one flaky test in `auth.test.ts` that flakes on Docker 24. I'll re-run CI now; if it fails twice, we'll skip test in release branch and file follow-up.

jamie: Noted. If we need to skip, annotate the PR with `skip-release` label and leave a comment linking issue.

kai: I'd prefer we don't skip runtime tests. If we must, coordinate with infra to run the failing suite on a warm instance to reduce flake.

alex: Agreed. Thanks everyone. I'll post a quick checklist and the merge schedule in ~1h. :thumbsup:

maria: thx! :rocket:

jamie: :+1:

deploy-bot: Reminder in 50m: release-train healthcheck.

alex: (private) tagging @jamie @maria for merge window 22:00-23:30 PDT — I'll handle the cross-repo version tag after merges:```
git tag -a v1.12.0 -m "Release v1.12.0"
git push origin v1.12.0
```

maria: noted, will be online.

End of thread.
